title: Asking the Right Questions: Ontology-Grounded Interpretable Embeddings for Biomedical Text
abstract: arXiv:2603.01690v3 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: While dense biomedical embeddings achieve strong performance, their opaque dimensions limit transparency in biomedical NLP. Recent question-based interpretable embeddings represent text through binary answers to natural-language questions, but existing approaches rely primarily on corpus-driven signals, often capturing topical or stylistic differences rather than fine-grained biomedical distinctions. We propose QIME, an ontology-grounded framework for interpretable biomedical text embeddings in which each dimension corresponds to an explicit biomedical-domain yes/no question. QIME leverages a biomedical ontology to guide contrastive question generation from semantic clusters, producing atomic, domain-grounded questions. It constructs embeddings via similarity-based semantic activation with MMR-based diversity-aware dimension selection, yielding sparse representations efficiently. translated_title: 提出正确的问题：面向生物医学文本的本体驱动可解释嵌入
translated_abstract: 虽然稠密生物医学嵌入取得了强大的性能，但其不透明的维度限制了生物医学自然语言处理的透明度。近年来基于问题的可解释嵌入通过自然语言问题的二元答案来表示文本，但现有方法主要依赖语料库驱动的信号，往往捕捉的是主题或文体上的差异，而非细粒度的生物医学区别。我们提出了QIME，一个基于本体的可解释生物医学文本嵌入框架，其中每个维度对应一个明确的生物医学领域“是/否”问题。QIME利用生物医学本体来指导从语义簇中生成对比性问题，产生原子化、领域根基扎实的问题。它通过基于相似度的语义激活，结合基于MMR的多样性感知维度选择来构建嵌入，从而高效地生成稀疏表示。在生物医学聚类、STS和检索等实验中……（原文摘要到此截断）
tldr: 本文提出QIME框架，利用生物医学本体指导生成明确的领域“是/否”问题作为嵌入维度，实现了稀疏、高效且可解释的生物医学文本表示。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes QIME, an ontology-grounded framework that uses explicit biomedical yes/no questions as embedding dimensions to achieve sparse, efficient, and interpretable biomedical text representations.
